record.paper_title: Open Problems on Ultrafilters and Some Connections to the Continuum
record.original_question: Let D be a regular ultrafilter on λ. Give an internal set-theoretic characterization of a family F of monotonic functions from [λ]^{<ℵ0} to D that is minimal, in an appropriate sense, for the following property: if every f in F has a multiplicative refinement, then D is good.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\lambda$ be an infinite cardinal and let $D$ be a regular ultrafilter on $\lambda$ (recall that $D$ is regular if there exists a family $\{X_\alpha : \alpha<\lambda\}\subseteq D$ such that the intersection of any infinitely many of the $X_\alpha$ is empty). For a function $f:[\lambda]^{<\aleph_0}\to D$, say that $f$ is monotonic if $u\subseteq v$ implies $f(u)\supseteq f(v)$, and say that a function $g:[\lambda]^{<\aleph_0}\to D$ is a multiplicative refinement of $f$ if $g(u)\subseteq f(u)$ for all $u\in[\lambda]^{<\aleph_0}$ and $g(u\cup v)=g(u)\cap g(v)$ for all $u,v\in[\lambda]^{<\aleph_0}$. The ultrafilter $D$ is said to be good (more precisely, $\lambda^+$-good) if every monotonic $f:[\lambda]^{<\aleph_0}\to D$ has a multiplicative refinement.

Consider the property $(\ast)$ of a family $\mathcal F$ of monotonic functions $[\lambda]^{<\aleph_0}\to D$: if every $f\in\mathcal F$ admits a multiplicative refinement, then $D$ is good. Provide an internal set-theoretic characterization (i.e., one phrased purely in terms of the combinatorial structure of $\mathcal F$ and of subsets of $\lambda$, without quantifying over all monotonic functions) of those families $\mathcal F$ that are minimal, in an appropriate sense, with respect to property $(\ast)$.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as a general open problem about characterizing minimal families of monotonic functions whose multiplicative refinements suffice to witness goodness of a regular ultrafilter. Recent surveys and works on ultrafilter constructions and Keisler's order (e.g., Malliaris's 2025 survey on ultrafilter construction and Parente's thesis on regularity of ultrafilters) continue to treat goodness via multiplicative refinements of monotonic functions but do not provide such an internal minimal characterization, so the problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: On Ultrafilter Construction (Malliaris)
status_evidence.snippet: Recent survey of ultrafilter constructions related to goodness and Keisler's order, treating multiplicative refinements of monotonic functions but not providing an internal characterization of minimal families.
status_evidence.claim: The problem of an internal characterization of minimal families witnessing goodness is still under active investigation.

status_evidence.title: Regularity of ultrafilters, Boolean ultrapowers, and Keisler's order (Parente)
status_evidence.snippet: Reviews goodness defined via monotonic functions [λ]^{<ω} → D having multiplicative refinements; does not give an internal minimality characterization.
status_evidence.claim: No internal characterization of minimal families with the stated property is known.
